title: Binary principal-unit wild-Kloosterman amplitude bound
statement: For every integer ell >= 2, put R = GF(2)[x]/(x^(ell+1)) and let psi(z) = (-1)^[x^ell]z. For every c in R, the sum K_2(c) over units u in R of psi(u^(-1)+cu) has absolute value at most 2^(ell+1-ceil(ell/3)).
notes: A specialized stationary-phase proof is recorded in docs/research/10-cas/lemire-half-degree-irreducibles.md and its closed-form arithmetic consequences are exposed by axeyum_cas::gf2_hayes::principal_unit_kloosterman_bound. Exhaustive direct tests through ell=9 are mutation controls, not a universal certificate. The fact remains open to Axeyum because no registered Autogenesis operation or kernel term independently checks the quantified stationary-phase argument. It is not a direct dependency of the all-degree Lemire fact: a cancellation-preserving prime decomposition is still missing.
